scripts.test: node scripts/test-queue.js --shell 'npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration'
scripts.test:unit: node scripts/test-queue.js --shell 'npm run test:runner && node scripts/run-vitest.js run tests/unit'
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/test-queue.js node scripts/run-vitest.js run tests/integration
scripts.test:visual: node scripts/test-queue.js node scripts/run-vitest.js run tests/visual
scripts.test:perf: node scripts/test-queue.js node scripts/run-vitest.js run tests/perf
scripts.test:ci: node scripts/test-queue.js --shell 'export VECTURA_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS=${VECTURA_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS:-10800000} && npm run test:runner && npm run test:coverage -- --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile.json=coverage/vitest-full.json && npm run test:profile -- --strict --results coverage/vitest-full.json --output coverage/full-profile.json && npm run test:audit:proofs && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:perf'
scripts.test:feedback:run: node scripts/test-queue.js --shell 'npm run test:runner && node scripts/run-feedback-vitest.js && playwright test tests/e2e/feedback.spec.js --reporter=line'
scripts.test:audit: node scripts/test-queue.js --shell 'export VECTURA_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS=${VECTURA_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS:-10800000} && npm run test:runner && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:audit:proofs && npm run test:e2e'
scripts.test:audit:proofs: node scripts/test-queue.js node scripts/run-vitest.js run tests/audit
scripts.test:coverage: VECTURA_TEST_COVERAGE=1 node scripts/test-queue.js node scripts/run-vitest.js run --coverage
scripts.test:e2e:touch:journeys:ledger: rm -rf test-results/journey-ledger && JOURNEY_LEDGER_WRITE=1 playwright test tests/e2e/touch/journeys.spec.js --project=touch-ipad-portrait --project=touch-ipad-landscape --project=touch-iphone-portrait --project=touch-iphone-landscape --project='webkit-*' --reporter=dot; node tests/e2e/touch/merge-ledger.js
scripts.hooks:install: HOOKS_DIR="$(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/hooks" && cp scripts/hooks/pre-commit "$HOOKS_DIR/pre-commit" && cp scripts/hooks/pre-push "$HOOKS_DIR/pre-push" && chmod +x "$HOOKS_DIR/pre-commit" "$HOOKS_DIR/pre-push"
